info.title: Waaru Developer API
info.description: Source contract for this release; deployment requires release verification. Keys remain number-bound. Explicit workspace:* scopes cover all workspace contacts/static segments. All operations require a connected EXTERNAL_API number. Unknown input fields are rejected. Canonical phone validation, custom-field catalog policies, template freshness/quality and messaging rules are runtime constraints in addition to the schema.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist one unique value per logical send. Same normalized recipient and content repeats acceptance; changed request returns409. Scope is workspace and number, including after key rotation.
